model.masses: decision 1: each mapped body slot's Avatar m_HumanBoneMass entry, renormalized over the mapped slots; E0b compares it with the fold of HumanTrait's own default masses (the recorder's hierarchy masses less their children's)
model.mass_points: 2.1 H-pos: a mass point is p_i + sum_j a_ij (p_j - p_i) over the edges to the nearest mapped human descendants, one coefficient per edge, left and right separate
model.frame: 2.2: up = mid(upper arms) - mid(upper legs), lateral = (R - L UpperArm) + (R - L UpperLeg), forward = lateral x up, right = up x forward; bodyRotation = F(pose) F(T)^-1
model.lateral: section 8: 2.2 and 2.3 hold up to the lateral limit, the largest spine Left-Right value of a training sample below every failing sample's in E2 and E3a, and at least one step below those
model.solve: 2.3: closed form, H_A = B_A F(T) F_h^-1, P_A = h T_A - k H_A c_h, k = sigma_p s_h
model.root: 2.4: X_A = X_r^-1 o X_b, the m_StartAtOrigin rebase shared by root and body
model.yaw: 2.4: a yaw is the twist about up, 2 atan2(q_y, q_w)
model.height_from_feet: 2.4: undecided between candidates A and B; refused
model.topology_scope: section 8: refused when Chest or Neck is absent, exactly one Shoulder is mapped, an Eye or the Jaw has a nonzero mass, or the absent body slots other than the zero-mass leaves (Eyes, Jaw) are not a recorded training pattern
model.frame_scope: section 8: refused when the shoulder-hip twist about up exceeds 4.25 degrees or is undefined

refusals.topology: an Avatar outside the training rigs' recorded topologies (scope.topologies)
refusals.frame: a shoulder-hip twist over bounds.twist_limit, or an undefined one
refusals.spine_lateral_range: a spine Left-Right muscle over scope.lateral_limit

bounds.comparison: each hips translation component within T_s = E_unity,s + u_s + E_eval,s, with u_s <= E_unity,s

e4.note: per configuration (variant/rig/Editor version/root placement): B4 and B5 implement the passing ones alone; excluded ones compared nothing
